title: Initial Block After a Recent Psychiatric Admission, Referrals and Authorizations Approvals
content:
When a TRICARE Prime request under **Referrals and Authorizations** is approved to the network provider after the military clinic's response window has passed, a readmission shortens the initial block of days approved.

## Records read

From the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines: whether an inpatient mental health admission line of the patient is dated in the last month, and the date of the patient's most recent emergency department visit.

## Rule

| Inpatient mental health admission line dated in the last month | Most recent emergency department visit | Initial block |
|---|---|---|
| yes | dated no more than 7 days ago | 3 days |
| yes | dated more than 7 days ago, or none on record | 5 days |
| no | any | the type's default units authorized |

In words: where an inpatient mental health admission line of the patient is dated in the last month and an emergency department visit is dated no more than seven days ago, the block is three days; where such an admission line is dated in the last month and no emergency visit is that recent, the block is five days; otherwise the block is the type's default units authorized.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; request approved on 20 May, admission line dated 2 May)

- Most recent emergency visit 13 May (7 days before): block of 3 days.
- Most recent emergency visit 12 May (8 days before): block of 5 days.
